name: creation_groups
description: The admin-managed list of valid group tags. Everything else — a contribution's groups, a member's list, a moderator's scope — refers to a row here.

columns.name: tag
columns.description: Stored WITHOUT the leading '#'. An implementation that stores or compares it with the '#' will not match legacy data.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The human label. NULL means the tag is its own label.

columns.name: hashtags_adopted_at
columns.description: When the inline hashtags that predate the group field were last adopted into this group. NULL means never — which is true for every group created before the adoption existed.
columns.note: LEGACY-HASHTAG-ADOPTION: goes away with the feature.

columns.name: hashtags_adopted_count
columns.description: How many contributions that run adopted.
columns.note: LEGACY-HASHTAG-ADOPTION: goes away with the feature.

notes: The table was called group_tags until migration 0110 renamed it, along with contribution_group_tags -> contribution_creation_groups, user_group_tags -> user_creation_groups, contributions.group_tags_set_at -> creation_groups_set_at and user_roles.visible_group_tags -> visible_creation_groups. A migration reading a database older than 0110 finds the old names.
The unique on tag is what makes the tag usable as the wire identifier: routes take and return tags, not ids. See server/backend/creation-group.json.
Timestamps are UTC milliseconds; see types/Timestamp.json. This table uses datetime(3).
